narrative.northStar: Papan Kelas Ceria (The Cheerful Classroom Board)
narrative.overview: Bunayo looks like a well-kept classroom wall: warm paper instead of sterile white, ink instead of pure black, and six crayon colours pinned up by the children's own names. The system is "premium yang ceria" — premium-plain structure (bordered panels, tabular numbers, one action colour) carrying a cheerful layer (whole cards painted in a child's or class's crayon colour, one authored motion vocabulary, a photo-led hero). The foundation is the desktop admin kit ("Arah B — Papan Kelas"); the Parent/Tutor portals mount it inside .app-mobile and add the cheerful layer as a documented sub-system. Every number on screen is real data from the classroom — no invented balances, promos, or testimonials. Warmth comes from colour fields and language, never from decoration: cheerfulness is structural, the crayon field is the card.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper base (#FFFCF5/#F7F2E9) with ink text (#1D1A2D); dark mode is a hue-faithful inversion, not a separate design.
One blue action (#2046C4) on desktop; on mobile portals the primary action is the Tinta ink pill.
Six crayons (Tomat, Matahari, Daun, Langit, Anggur, Permen) in three steps each — base / soft / ink — assigned deterministically per child, class, and activity type.
Bricolage Grotesque display over IBM Plex Sans body; mono numerals on desktop, tabular sans numerals inside .app-mobile.
Line-first depth: 1px borders for cards, three shadow tokens reserved for things that float.
One motion vocabulary: rise-in entrances, press scale-down, tiba-dot ping — all silenced by prefers-reduced-motion.
PWA polish: per-scheme theme-color, safe-area padding, pill composer, 68px floating tab bar.

rules.name: The One Ink Pill Rule
rules.body: On Parent/Tutor mobile portals there is one primary action per screen and it is the Tinta ink pill (52px tall, fully rounded, press-scale). Biru Bunayo is the desktop primary, never a mobile CTA.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Crayon Rule
rules.body: Text on a base crayon field is always Tinta (#1D1A2D, via .field-ink, ≥6:1, both schemes); white text appears only over photos, under the Tinta scrim gradient. Secondary text on crayon fields is Tinta at 72% opacity (.field-sub), never grey.

rules.name: The Six-Crayon Rule
rules.body: Only six crayons exist. Entity colour is derived, not chosen: krayonDari(id) hashes the child/class ID, KRAYON_KEGIATAN maps activity types — the same child is the same colour on every screen. A new category must map onto an existing crayon, not add a seventh.

rules.name: The Stabilo Rule
rules.body: Stabilo marks exactly one thing per screen — the number or phrase the user must not miss. A screen with two highlights has none.

rules.name: The Two-Numeral Rule
rules.body: .tabular is the only numeral treatment, and the scheme switches by context, not per-screen: mono on desktop/admin, tabular sans inside .app-mobile. Never hand-pick a font for a number.

rules.name: The Reduced-Scale Rule
rules.body: Mobile display type tops out at 30px (child name). The kit's 34px stat scale belongs to desktop admin screens only.

rules.name: The Line-First Rule
rules.body: A card gets a Garis border, not a shadow. Shadows are earned by leaving the document flow (nav, sheets, sticky actions) — a card that merely sits on the page stays flat.

dos: Do derive every entity colour through krayonDari(id) / KRAYON_KEGIATAN — same child, class, or activity = same crayon on every screen, both schemes.
Do wrap crayon-field content in .field-ink so text stays Tinta ≥6:1; use .field-sub (Tinta/72%) for secondary lines.
Do make the mobile primary action the ink pill (h-btn-lg rounded-full bg-foreground text-background + .press); keep Biru Bunayo for the desktop kit's primary and for links/selection on mobile.
Do put .tabular on every numeral — it resolves to mono on desktop and tabular sans inside .app-mobile automatically.
Do animate with the three moves only: .rise (0.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), stagger .rise-2/.rise-3 at 60/120ms), .press (scale .97, 0.18s), .tiba-dot (ping ×2, 1.6s).
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion (rise, press, tiba, skeletons all switch off) and keep targets ≥44px.
Do ship the PWA pair: theme-color #F7F2E9 (light) / #100F15 (dark), safe-area padding, content reserved above the 68px tab bar.
Do mark demo/simulated sessions with a labelled banner and keep real data the only content.
donts: Don't use emoji as icons — icons are inline Lucide SVGs at 16–24px.
Don't ship blue rectangle CTAs on the Parent/Tutor mobile portals; the ink pill is the primary. (Biru Bunayo kit buttons on desktop keep their 12px radius.)

Don't add coloured side-stripes to mobile list rows — colour arrives through icon ink, soft avatar fills, or whole crayon fields. The desktop kit's Feed crayon rail is legacy kit, not the mobile vocabulary.
Don't invent a seventh crayon, a new status hue, or a hardcoded entity colour.
Don't put white text on base crayon fields; white appears only over photos, under the Tinta scrim.
Don't fake data — no invented bank accounts, promos, testimonials, or user counts; hide unfinished features instead.
Don't resurrect the 34px mockup display scale on mobile (page title 26, child name 30, class name 28, section title 18).
Don't use more than one blue primary, one Stabilo highlight, or one ink pill per screen.
